debate.key_bull_argument: Momentum indicators (MACD, PPO, Hull, OBV, Force Index) show synchronized bullish crossovers with price near support (47.39), offering a defined risk entry in extreme fear conditions (VIX 367).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is trapped below all key moving averages (EMA-21, EMA-50, SMA-50) and Ichimoku cloud with StochRSI overbought, ADX weak, and macro environment unfavorable—momentum divergence from price structure signals false breakout risk.
